cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

format.description: Output encoding. compact is columnar and is what you want; json is the raw Prometheus shape and costs ten to fifty times more tokens; table is fixed-width text.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Rows are ranked by descending value, so a truncated result keeps the largest.

query.description: PromQL expression to evaluate at a single instant, e.g. sum by(job) (up == 0).

time.description: Evaluation instant. Relative ("now", "now-15m", "-1h") or RFC 3339 ("2026-08-29T12:00:00Z") or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now.
